2026_primary.fact: Corrected after blind pass (DECISIONS 44). Page images read: 'Cumulative Results Report MEDINA COUNTY, TEXAS ... Unofficial Results ... 2026 JOINT PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 ... Run Time 9:47 PM Run Date 03/03/2026 ... Precincts Reporting 15 of 15 = 100.00%', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day (e.g. KEN PAXTON 43 / 2,123 / 1,124 / 3,290), page 20 ends '*** End of report ***'; no precinct numbers. The only precinct report on that page (Official Precinct Results.pdf) has Last-Modified Fri, 13 Mar 2026 16:11:41 GMT. DECISIONS 67 (i) and (ii) met.
